mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS below 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise) fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising), the Federal Reserve's policy action increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1900.0 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and weak demand for residential construction, which negatively impacts the broader economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST is below 1900.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown across the housing sector and manufacturing, which erodes corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST decline and INDPRO decline) fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-average monthly consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals elevated inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
